lines.gurmukhi: ਊਤਮੁ ਊਚੌ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੇਖ ॥
lines.transliteration: ootam oochau paarabraham gun a(n)t na jaanahi sekh ||
lines.translation: that the Supreme Lord God is the most sublime and lofty. Even the thousand-tongued serpent does not know the limits of His Glories.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਦ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੁਕ ਬਿਆਸ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: naarad mun jan suk biaas jas gaavat gobi(n)d ||
lines.translation: Naarad, the humble beings, Suk and Vyaasa sing the Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸ ਗੀਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬੀਧੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਚੇ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: ras geedhe har siu beedhe bhagat rache bhagava(n)t ||
lines.translation: They are imbued with the Lord's essence; united with Him; they are absorbed in devotional worship of the Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਮਾਨ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਪਾਈ ਸਰਨਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: moh maan bhram binasio paaee saran daiaal ||
lines.translation: Emotional attachment, pride and doubt are eliminated, when one takes to the Sanctuary of the Merciful Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal man tan base darasan dekh nihaal ||
lines.translation: His Lotus Feet abide within my mind and body and I am enraptured, beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਭੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤੋਟਾ ਹਿਰੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: laabh milai totaa hirai saadhasa(n)g liv laai ||
lines.translation: People reap their profits, and suffer no loss, when they embrace love for the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਟਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: khaat khajaanaa gun nidh hare naanak naam dhiaai ||6||
lines.translation: They gather in the treasure of the Lord, the Ocean of Excellence, O Nanak, by meditating on the Naam. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਥਹਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਸਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t ma(n)dal har jas kathahi bolahi sat subhaai ||
lines.translation: In the gathering of the Saints, chant the Praises of the Lord, and speak the Truth with love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਐ ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak man sa(n)tokheeai ekas siu liv laai ||7||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the mind becomes contented, enshrining love for the One Lord. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਪਤਮਿ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਟੂਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sapatam sa(n)chahu naam dhan toot na jaahi bha(n)daar ||
lines.translation: The seventh day of the lunar cycle: Gather the wealth of the Naam; this is a treasure which shall never be exhausted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)gat mahi paaeeai a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
lines.translation: In the Society of the Saints, He is obtained; He has no end or limitations.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਤਜਹੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਹੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap tajahu gobi(n)d bhajahu saran parahu har raai ||
lines.translation: Renounce your selfishness and conceit, and meditate, vibrate on the Lord of the Universe; take to the Sanctuary of the Lord, our King.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਹਰੈ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dookh harai bhavajal tarai man chi(n)diaa phal paai ||
lines.translation: Your pains shall depart - swim across the terrifying world-ocean, and obtain the fruits of your mind's desires.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੈ ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar man har japai saphal janam paravaan ||
lines.translation: One who meditates on the Lord twenty-four hours a day - fruitful and blessed is his coming into the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar baahar sadaa sa(n)g karanaihaar pachhaan ||
lines.translation: Inwardly and outwardly, realize that the Creator Lord is always with you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸੋ ਸਖਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: so saajan so sakhaa meet jo har kee mat dei ||
lines.translation: He is your friend, your companion, your very best friend, who imparts the Teachings of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇਇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tis balihaaranai har har naam japei ||7||
lines.translation: Nanak is a sacrifice to one who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈਅਹਿ ਤਜੀਅਹਿ ਅਵਰਿ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar gun gaaeeahi tajeeahi avar ja(n)jaal ||
lines.translation: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord twenty-four hours a day; renounce other entanglements.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: jamaka(n)kar johi na sakaee naanak prabhoo daiaal ||8||
lines.translation: The Minister of Death cannot even see that person, O Nanak, unto whom God is merciful. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਸਟਮੀ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: asatamee asat sidh nav nidh ||
lines.translation: The eighth day of the lunar cycle: The eight spiritual powers of the Siddhas, the nine treasures,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਬੁਧਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal padaarath pooran budh ||
lines.translation: all precious things, perfect intellect,

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਵਲ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਆਨੰਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaval pragaas sadaa aana(n)d ||
lines.translation: the opening of the heart-lotus, eternal bliss,

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ਨਿਰੋਧਰ ਮੰਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: niramal reet nirodhar ma(n)t ||
lines.translation: pure lifestyle, the infallible Mantra,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਧਰਮ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal dharam pavitr isanaan ||
lines.translation: all Dharmic virtues, sacred purifying baths,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਊਚ ਬਿਸੇਖ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh mahi ooch bisekh giaan ||
lines.translation: the most lofty and sublime spiritual wisdom

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har bhajan poore gur sa(n)g ||
lines.translation: these are obtained by meditating, vibrating upon the Lord, Har, Har, in the Company of the Perfect Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: jap tareeai naanak naam har ra(n)g ||8||
lines.translation: You shall be saved, O Nanak, by lovingly chanting the Lord's Name. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਨਹ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਸੁਆਦ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: naaraain nah simario mohio suaad bikaar ||
lines.translation: He does not remember the Lord in meditation; he is fascinated by the pleasures of corruption.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਐ ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam bisaariai narak surag avataar ||9||
lines.translation: O Nanak, forgetting the Naam, he is reincarnated into heaven and hell. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਉਮੀ ਨਵੇ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਅਪਵੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: naumee nave chhidr apaveet ||
lines.translation: The ninth day of the lunar cycle: The nine holes of the body are defiled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪਹਿ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam na japahi karat bipareet ||
lines.translation: People do not chant the Lord's Name; instead, they practice evil.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਰਮਹਿ ਬਕਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਨਿੰਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: par tri ramahi bakahi saadh ni(n)d ||
lines.translation: They commit adultery, slander the Saints,

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਨ ਸੁਨਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਬਿੰਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: karan na sunahee har jas bi(n)d ||
lines.translation: and do not listen to even a tiny bit of the Lord's Praise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਹਿ ਪਰ ਦਰਬੁ ਉਦਰ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hirahi par darab udar kai taaee ||
lines.translation: They steal others' wealth for the sake of their own bellies,

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਨਿਵਰੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: agan na nivarai trisanaa na bujhaaee ||
lines.translation: but the fire is not extinguished, and their thirst is not quenched.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਏਹ ਫਲ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har sevaa bin eh phal laage ||
lines.translation: Without serving the Lord, these are their rewards.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਮਰਿ ਜਮਹਿ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak prabh bisarat mar jamahi abhaage ||9||
lines.translation: O Nanak, forgetting God, the unfortunate people are born, only to die. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਦਿਸ ਖੋਜਤ ਮੈ ਫਿਰਿਓ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: das dis khojat mai phirio jat dekhau tat soi ||
lines.translation: I have wandered, searching in the ten directions - wherever I look, there I see Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਬਸਿ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: man bas aavai naanakaa je pooran kirapaa hoi ||10||
lines.translation: The mind comes to be controlled, O Nanak, if He grants His Perfect Grace. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਸਮੀ ਦਸ ਦੁਆਰ ਬਸਿ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dasamee das duaar bas keene ||
lines.translation: The tenth day of the lunar cycle: Overpower the ten sensory and motor organs;

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨਾਮ ਜਪਿ ਲੀਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man sa(n)tokh naam jap leene ||
lines.translation: your mind will be content, as you chant the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਨੀ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਜਸੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: karanee suneeai jas gopaal ||
lines.translation: With your ears, hear the Praises of the Lord of the World;

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੈਨੀ ਪੇਖਤ ਸਾਧ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: nainee pekhat saadh daiaal ||
lines.translation: with your eyes, behold the kind, Holy Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਬੇਅੰਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: rasanaa gun gaavai bea(n)t ||
lines.translation: With your tongue, sing the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mahi chitavai pooran bhagava(n)t ||
lines.translation: In your mind, remember the Perfect Lord God.
